thread:
alex chen: Heads up — PR #8245 is ready for merge but I'm seeing a small microbatch throughput dip on the canary. need quick approvals and a sanity check on batch config.

maya rao: pinging reviewers @samir @jordan. can you eyeball the numbers?

samir patel: looking now. can you paste the bench output? brief summary is fine.

alex chen: sure — pasted below. this is 1k requests with batch_size=8 on a p4d-like instance. baseline is main before the change, candidate is after my allocator tweak.

```
baseline: throughput=12.8 req/s  p95=46ms  p99=92ms  mem_rss=48.1GB
candidate: throughput=11.2 req/s  p95=49ms  p99=110ms mem_rss=50.3GB
delta: -12.5% throughput, +2.2GB RSS, tail bump
```

alex chen: full run + artifacts: https://bench.redwood.internal/8245/canary-2026-03-17.txt (contains per-shard results and flamegraphs)

jordan li: thanks. interesting — throughput drop concentrated on longer contexts? what's the avg seq len distribution for this run?

alex chen: avg seq len ~220 tokens; I also ran quick longseq subset (seq>1024) and saw negligible change there — the delta is most prominent at short-to-medium sequences.

maya rao: that suggests batching scheduling change may be causing more small-batch overhead. which part of the allocator tweak could do that?

samir patel: reading the PR — you moved allocation reclamation earlier to reduce fragmentation, and added an extra mutex in hot path for the microbatch queue. can we try the bench with the reclaim disabled? should be a quick comment flip.

alex chen: yes i can run that. will flip reclaim=false and re-run microbench. give me ~12m.

ci-bot: build #8245-canary passed; perf-run queued (id: pr-8245-345).

(alex chen later): quick rerun with reclaim=false:
```
repro-run: throughput=12.6 req/s  p95=46ms  p99=95ms mem_rss=48.5GB
```
looks much closer to baseline; reclaim appears to be the culprit.

samir patel: OK that isolates it. can you add a flag gate and a test to toggle reclaim so we can roll it out gradually and keep it off for small-batch workloads? also add a note in PR description with the bench snippet.

ajordan li: +1 on the feature flag. also add a microbench in CI for small batches so this doesn't regress silently.

alex chen: will do both now. estimated extra changes + tests ~30m. after that, request for approvals.

maya rao: thanks. @samir @jordan can we aim to review the updated PR in the next 45m? if both okay we'll merge and canary promote.

samir patel: on it. after the flag and test i'll do a quick review.

jordan li: same here. if you post the new bench links i'll give a final check. :thumbsup:

alex chen: thanks team — pushing updates shortly.
